tasks.name: Eight-direction flat-ground velocity tracking
tasks.description: Track a 0.4 m/s planar command in all eight directions of the source protocol while keeping the across-direction mean heading error within 10 degrees.
tasks.source_task_or_operation: Lee et al. Fig. 3F-G eight-direction 0.4 m/s flat-ground tracking experiment.
tasks.applicability: Go2 exposes the same free planar base and twelve actuated leg joints as the source quadruped.
tasks.adaptation: The Framework executes all eight source directions as independently reset repetitions. The 0.4 m/s command and 10 degree bound are unchanged.
scene_assumptions: A level rigid floor provides at least 4 m of unobstructed travel in the commanded direction.
observation_assumptions: The Framework samples canonical MuJoCo body poses, contacts, and time; the candidate does not receive private bindings or verdicts.
All success values are recomputed by the trusted Harness from actuator-driven physics steps.

source_refs.specific_reference: Fig. 3F and Results pp. 4-5: target speed is fixed to 0.4 m/s and the presented controller locomotes at around 0.4 m/s in all eight directions.
Fig. 3G and Results p. 5: heading error is the angle between command and base velocity, and average error stays within 10 degrees.

observation_assumptions: The Framework samples canonical MuJoCo body poses, contacts, and time; the candidate does not receive private bindings or verdicts.

source_refs.specific_reference: Results p. 4: each trial runs straight for 10 s; success requires both front and hind legs to traverse the step; ten trials are run per height.
source_refs.adaptation: Obstacle lengths are multiplied by 0.54, the recorded ratio of the Go2 0.27 m nominal base height to the source ANYmal 0.50 m height; time, success definition, repetition count, and normalized difficulty are unchanged.

tasks.name: Payload step ascent

scene_assumptions: The canonical payload model adds 22.7% of nominal mass at the trunk and provides one confined rigid step.
observation_assumptions: The Framework samples canonical MuJoCo body poses, contacts, and time; the candidate does not receive private bindings or verdicts.
All success values are recomputed by the trusted Harness from actuator-driven physics steps.

source_refs.specific_reference: Results pp. 4-5: the 10 kg payload is 22.7% of total mass and the controller traverses a 13.4 cm step; step success and ten-trial aggregation follow Fig. 3D-E.
source_refs.adaptation: Payload mass is 22.7% of the exact local MJCF mass; step height uses the recorded 0.54 morphology scale. No success or repetition requirement is weakened.

tasks.name: Barkour pause-table transition

tasks.adaptation: All dimensions, torso-distance acceptance radii, and five-second dwell are retained.
scene_assumptions: Two fixed 1 x 1 x 0.1 m hard non-slip tables use source dimensions.
observation_assumptions: The Framework samples canonical MuJoCo body poses, contacts, and time; the candidate does not receive private bindings or verdicts.

source_refs.specific_reference: Appendix B.1: stepping off succeeds when torso center moves 0.7 m from the start-table center.
Appendix B.1 and C.1: step-on succeeds within 0.4 m of table center and a valid run stands on the end table for 5 s.
